Summary:
Adobe ColdFusion is prone to a directory traversal vulnerability
  because it fails to sufficiently sanitize user-supplied input.
Impact:
Exploiting this issue may allow an attacker to obtain sensitive
  information that could aid in further attacks.
Solution:
Updates are available. Please see the references for more
  information.
Affected Software/OS:
Adobe ColdFusion version 9.0.1 and prior is known to be
  affected.
Vulnerability Detection Method:
Sends multiple crafted HTTP POST requests and checks the
  responses.
Details:
Adobe ColdFusion Directory Traversal Vulnerability (APSB10-18)
